patches.name: AI Writing Tools
patches.description:
啟用 AI 撰寫工具，支援所有語言
Enable AI writing tools with support for all languages.

patches.name: AMOLED Dark Keyboard
patches.description: Turns Gboard's Material You dark keyboard surfaces pure AMOLED black (#000000) instead of grey while leaving the light theme, accent colors, and key faces unchanged. Ported from nl-morphe-patches for Gboard 18.5.4.

patches.name: Access Points menu style
patches.description:
切換新版或舊版 Access Points 選單樣式
Switch between the new and legacy Access Points menu styles.

patches.name: Add Gboard Signature Bypass
patches.description:
攔截 Gboard 的簽章白名單檢查並強制通過
Bypass Gboard signature whitelist checks and force them to pass.

patches.name: Advanced Voice Typing
patches.description:
啟用進階語音輸入（包含自動標點功能），並另外為不支援進階語音輸入的繁體中文語音啟用自動標點
Enable Advanced Voice Typing with automatic punctuation, and separately enable automatic punctuation for Traditional Chinese voice typing, which does not support Advanced Voice Typing.

patches.name: At-Mention & Email Strip Suggestions
patches.description: Native Gboard suggestion-strip personalized @handle and email domain suggestions: renders directly inside Gboard's own themed suggestion bar (zero floating overlay; matches AMOLED Dark, Material You, Frosted Glass & Custom Themes), learns typed/sent/dictated @mentions (e.g. @grok, @claude) without fixed standalone defaults, supports native drag-up-to-remove and Settings add/manage, and stays fail-closed in password/incognito fields for Gboard 18.5.4.

patches.name: Backup & Restore
patches.description:
匯出或還原 Patches 設定與 Gboard 個人化資料，並備份、比較及還原 Gboard PB/XML flag store
Export or restore Patches settings and Gboard personal data, and back up, compare, or restore the Gboard PB/XML flag store.

patches.name: Change emoji size
patches.description:
變更表情符號大小
Change emoji size.

patches.name: Clipboard Custom Character Limit
patches.description:
自訂每個文字剪貼簿項目的最大字元數
Customize the maximum character count for each text clipboard item.

patches.name: Clipboard Enhancements
patches.description:
增強剪貼簿的保留時間、數量上限、預覽行數、倒數/建立時間、順序編號與欄數
Enhance clipboard retention time, item count limit, preview lines, countdown/creation time labels, order index, and column count.

patches.name: Close Proactive Suggestions
patches.description:
在主動建議列顯示關閉按鈕
Show a dismiss button in the proactive suggestions bar.

patches.name: Custom Symbols
patches.description:
新增獨立的特殊符號分頁，長按逗號->愛心
Add a dedicated custom symbols tab and replace the long-press comma entry with a heart shortcut.

patches.name: Custom Theme
patches.description:
支援匯入自訂 ZIP 主題，並支援從 Rboard 官方儲存庫匯入精美主題。
Import custom ZIP themes and beautiful themes from the official Rboard repository.

patches.name: Developer options
patches.description:
啟用 開發人員選項 與 Flag 編輯器，你可以自己修改Flag的值
Enable Developer options and the Flag Editor, allowing you to modify flag values.

patches.name: Dictionaries & Predictions
patches.description:
可選擇字典、預測及輸入修正的資源版本
Choose resource versions for dictionaries, predictions, and input correction.

patches.name: Emojis, stickers & GIFs Tab Order
patches.description:
自訂 Gboard「Emojis, stickers & GIFs」底部 tabs 的排序，支援拖曳調整
Customize the bottom tab order in Gboard's Emojis, stickers & GIFs panel with drag-and-drop reordering.

patches.name: Enable Inline Autofill Suggestions
patches.description:
啟用內嵌自動填入建議
Enable Inline Autofill Suggestions

patches.name: Enable OCR / Scan Text
patches.description:
啟用 OCR / 掃描文字功能，支援 拉丁、中文、日文、韓文 與 天城文 辨識後端
Enable the OCR / Scan Text feature with Latin, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Devanagari recognition backends.

patches.name: Enable accessibility layout
patches.description:
啟用無障礙鍵盤配置
Enable accessibility layout.

patches.name: Enable cursor trackpad mode
patches.description:
長按空白鍵開啟游標觸控板與鎖定模式
Long-press the space bar to use cursor trackpad and lock modes.

patches.name: Enable split keyboard
patches.description:
啟用分離式鍵盤
Enable the split keyboard layout.

patches.name: English QWERTY Up-Flick Uppercase
patches.description:
英文 QWERTY 鍵盤上滑大小寫
Flick up on the English QWERTY keyboard to toggle uppercase and lowercase.

patches.name: FTP Server
patches.description:
新增區域網路 FTP 伺服器，支援檔案瀏覽、傳輸與下載續傳
Add a LAN FTP server with file browsing, transfers, and download resume.

patches.name: Floating Web Search
patches.description:
直接從 Gboard 開啟懸浮網頁，快速搜尋需要的資訊。
Open a floating web page directly from Gboard to quickly search for the information you need.

patches.name: Frosted Glass
patches.description:
為鍵盤加入即時背景模糊與自訂主題透明度。
Add live background blur and custom-theme opacity to the keyboard.

patches.name: G Logo on Spacebar
patches.description:
自訂空白鍵圖示、圖片、顏色及大小，並隱藏語言名稱
Choose a built-in or imported spacebar image, its colors and size, and hide the language label.

patches.name: Grammar Checker
patches.description:
啟用 修正和建議 > 文法檢查
Enable Text correction > Grammar check.

patches.name: Hidden Flags Override
patches.description: Applies curated Gboard 18.5.4 hidden/beta flags (direct quick-paste chip, Rambler toolbar overflow, preserve rewritten on revert, auto parallel retry, toolbar entry, UI persistence, emoji skin-tone replacement, email provider completion) through Gboard's own OVERRIDE flag store with live toggles inside Settings. Ported from nl-morphe-patches for Gboard 18.5.4.

patches.name: Incognito Mode Toggle
patches.description:
在 Access Point 工具列新增無痕模式切換按鈕，並可設定無痕模式下是否啟用剪貼簿與語音輸入
Add an Incognito toggle to the Access Point toolbar and configure clipboard and voice typing availability while Incognito mode is active.

patches.name: Inline Suggestions
patches.description:
啟用 修正和建議 > 智慧撰寫
Enable Text correction > Smart Compose.

patches.name: Key Shape Selection
patches.description:
啟用圓角按鍵，主題詳情 > 按鍵形狀
Enable Key shape in Theme details.

patches.name: Keypress Vibration Intensity Control
patches.description:
將按鍵震動由持續時間改為力度控制。
Control keypress vibration intensity instead of duration.

patches.name: Latin Globe Key Ignore Interval
patches.description:
新增英文鍵盤地球鍵忽略時間覆寫，可獨立控制輸入後切語言延遲
Add an independent English globe key ignore interval override for post-typing language-switch delay.

patches.name: Long-Press Editing Shortcuts
patches.description:
在英文 QWERTY 與注音鍵盤加入全選、復原、複製、剪下、貼上與重做長按快捷鍵
Add Select all, Undo, Copy, Cut, Paste, and Redo long-press shortcuts to English QWERTY and Zhuyin.

patches.name: Package Rename
patches.description:
將套件名稱改成可自訂的值(預設 dev.jason.com...latin)，並可自訂 App 名稱，以便共存安裝
Rename the package to a configurable name (default dev.jason.com...latin) and allow a custom app name so it can be installed alongside the official Gboard.

options.title: 套件名稱 / Package name
options.description:
必須是有效的 Android 套件名稱。選官方套件名稱 com.google.android.inputmethod.latin 時只改 App 名稱、不改套件名稱，無法與官方 Gboard 共存安裝；其他工具改過的套件名稱不受支援。
Must be a valid Android package name. Choosing the official package com.google.android.inputmethod.latin changes only the app name and keeps the package, so it cannot be installed alongside the official Gboard. Packages renamed by other tools are not supported.

patches.name: Quick Insert
patches.description:
啟用快速插入面板與工具列入口
Enable the Quick Insert panel and toolbar access point.

patches.name: Rambler App Context
patches.description: Enables sharing the active app name, input type, and field hint with Gboard Rambler (credited to nl-morphe-patches) with a live toggle in Rambler Enhancements. Verified on Gboard 18.5.4 (current GboardWu target); newer versions are best-effort and unverified.

patches.name: Rambler Bangla Lite Script Policy
patches.description: Fail-closed, SHA-256 fingerprint-guarded Bengali Unicode script policy for Gboard Rambler / Jetson Lite cleanup. Replaces the unconditional Hinglish/Banglish Romanization override with native-script preservation for bn-BD, bn-IN, and bn-Beng while preserving explicit bn-Latn Romanization. Verified on Gboard 18.5.4.

patches.name: Rambler Bangla Phonetic & Multilingual Engine
patches.description: Adds the full Rambler Bangla V29.3+ post-ASR Bengali phonetic & multilingual dictation engine: one-language-per-sentence AUTO routing, Avro-derived 2,265-pair Tier-1 normalization, CMUdict-derived English loanword transliteration in Bangla (e.g. company -> কোম্পানি), protected spans (#hashtags, @handles, URLs, emails, times), Unicode NFC normalization, fail-closed sensitive-field bypass, and native Settings toggles. Verified on Gboard 18.5.4.

patches.name: Rambler Contact Names
patches.description: Seeds up to 1,000 phone contact names into Rambler's MUSE_STATS voice dictionary (credited to nl-morphe-patches) when Contacts permission is granted, plus manual sync and reset controls. Verified on Gboard 18.5.4 (current GboardWu target); newer versions are best-effort and unverified.

patches.name: Rambler Cursor-Aware Editing
patches.description: Enables cursor-aware editing, selected-text-only spoken edits, optional post-edit reselection (off by default, credited to nl-morphe-patches), and a live Append-only dictation toggle with clean cursor-boundary spacing. Verified on Gboard 18.5.4 (current GboardWu target); newer versions are best-effort and unverified.

patches.name: Rambler Custom Instructions
patches.description: Enables persistent custom style/formatting instructions for Gboard Rambler (credited to nl-morphe-patches) with Per-app custom instructions (named app rules, searchable app picker, and disabled apps) in Gboard Settings -> Voice typing -> Rambler voice typing and Rambler Enhancements. Verified on Gboard 18.5.4 (current GboardWu target); newer versions are best-effort and unverified.

patches.name: Rambler Personal Dictionary
patches.description: Enables Gboard Rambler's UserFeatureCache MUSE_STATS personal voice dictionary (credited to nl-morphe-patches) with a live Use dictionary words toggle plus add, import/export (.txt), remove, and clear controls. Verified on Gboard 18.5.4 (current GboardWu target); newer versions are best-effort and unverified.

patches.name: Rambler Productivity Tools
patches.description: Adds Smart Search Bars (auto-strip trailing period + opt-in per-app Auto-Search on commit for Search & browser address bars), Long-press Spacebar for Rambler (Smart Hybrid / Hold-to-Talk / Toggle modes), a draggable Rambler toolbar quick-access button, 1-Tap Fix & Learn from Dictation History, private On-Device Dictation Stats (words, sessions, avg WPM, cloud latency, time saved vs typing), opt-in hands-free Voice Send & Search suffixes, deterministic Voice Snippets, post-dictation Find & Replace (plain or regex, global or per-app), Strip Trailing Period, private Local Dictation History (last 50 entries), Auto Parallel Retry on flaky networks, configurable Longer Dictation Sessions, and one-tap JSON Settings Backup & Restore. Verified on Gboard 18.5.4 (current GboardWu target); newer versions are best-effort and unverified.

patches.name: Rambler Toolbar & Revert Extras
patches.description: Enables Gboard 18.5.4's floating Rambler toolbar overflow menu, keeps rewritten text when reverting from the full transcript, and activates one-tap direct clipboard quick-paste. Ported from nl-morphe-patches for Gboard 18.5.4.

patches.name: Rambler Waveform Animation
patches.description: Replaces Gboard Rambler's light bar with Hex by Anomaly's animations. Listening (while you speak): Hex Dot Scope (braided dot oscilloscope), Hex Android Wave (7-row scrolling sine wave), or Gboard Default. Processing (after you stop speaking while transcribing): Flow, Pulse, or Sweep. Includes independent Listening/Processing colors and minimal Hex tuning (Strip trace vs iOS halo, dot spacing, glow, voice response). Works alongside upstream GboardWu (requires Advanced Voice Typing in GboardWu). Verified on Gboard 18.5.4 (current GboardWu target); newer versions are best-effort and unverified.

patches.name: Rounded Keyboard Panel
patches.description:
自訂鍵盤面板哪些角落呈現圓角，並分別設定上方與下方半徑。
Customize which corners of the keyboard panel are rounded, and set the top and bottom radii separately.

patches.name: Settings Homepage Override
patches.description:
允許切換新版或舊版 Gboard 設定頁面
Allow switching between the new and legacy Gboard settings pages.

patches.name: Shift + Backspace Forward Delete
patches.description:
按住 Shift 再按退格鍵，會刪除游標右邊的字，作用等同電腦鍵盤的 Delete 鍵。
Hold Shift and press Backspace to delete the character after the cursor, like the Delete key on a computer keyboard.

patches.name: Simple Calculator
patches.description:
直接輸入算式，在 Gboard 推薦列顯示可捲動算式與答案。
Type an expression and show a scrollable equation plus its answer in Gboard's suggestion row.

patches.name: Swipe Down to Dismiss Keyboard
patches.description:
從建議列或工具列向下滑動以關閉鍵盤。
Swipe down from the suggestions or toolbar to close the keyboard.

patches.name: Swipeable Custom Top Row
patches.description:
滑動鍵盤第一排，在原生列與可自訂文字/JavaScript 列之間切換
Swipe the keyboard top row to switch between the stock row and a customizable text/JavaScript row.

patches.name: Toolbar Editing Buttons
patches.description:
將全選、複製、剪下、貼上、向前刪除、行首／行尾、Tab 與方向鍵等按鈕加入選單。
Add editing and cursor buttons such as Select All, Copy, Cut, Paste, Forward Delete, Home/End, Tab, and arrows to the menu.

patches.name: Top Toolbar Item Count
patches.description:
自訂 Gboard 頂端工具列項目數量
Customize the Gboard top toolbar item count.

patches.name: Use Bluetooth Microphone
patches.description:
啟用 語音輸入 -> 使用藍芽麥克風
Enable Voice typing -> Use Bluetooth microphone.

patches.name: Web Clipboard
patches.description:
新增手機自架的 Web Clipboard，支援瀏覽器同步、配對碼與快速設定開關
Add the phone-hosted Web Clipboard with browser sync, pairing, and a Quick Settings Tile.

patches.name: Zhuyin Bottom Row Key Sizes
patches.description:
調整注音鍵盤底排按鍵大小
Adjust Zhuyin keyboard bottom-row key sizes.

patches.name: Zhuyin Quick Traditional/Simplified Toggle
patches.description:
注音 ㄥ 上滑快速切換繁簡
Swipe up on Zhuyin ㄥ to quickly toggle Traditional and Simplified Chinese.

patches.name: Zhuyin Slide Input
patches.description:
注音鍵盤支持上下滑輸入
Enable slide-up and slide-down input on the Zhuyin keyboard.
